section.title: Search
section.para: The text search of the issue filter (the search box of the filter, the search box of the menu bar) is answered by a search backend. The default one searches the database with SQL. The Meilisearch backend keeps its own index of the issues instead: it finds words and word prefixes, tolerates typos and ranks results by relevance, and is much faster on large databases.

Whatever the backend, the issues it finds are run through the issue filter like any other, so users never see issues they do not have access to. Text in private notes is only searched for users who can read private notes in the project.

section.title: Using Meilisearch

listitem.para: Run a Meilisearch server (version 1.11 or newer) that MantisBT can reach, and set its master key.
In config/config_inc.php, set $g_search_backend = 'meilisearch'; and the $g_search_meilisearch_* settings below. Run the database upgrade to create the table used by the search queue.
Create the index and fill it with the existing issues: php scripts/search_index.php --reindex
Run php scripts/search_index.php regularly, for example every minute from cron, to add the issues that changed since. --status shows whether the server can be reached and how many issues are waiting.

section.para: If Meilisearch cannot be reached, searches use the SQL search until it is available again, and changes are kept in the queue. Search results from Meilisearch are limited to $g_search_candidate_limit issues before the rest of the filter is applied.

listitem.para: The search backend: database (the default) or meilisearch. Other backends are classes named core/classes/Search<Name>Backend.class.php.
The maximum number of issues an indexed backend returns for a search. The default is 500 (Meilisearch returns at most 1000).
The address of the Meilisearch server. The default is http://localhost:7700.
The API key for Meilisearch: its master key, or a key that may manage and search the index. Empty by default.
The name of the index that holds the issues. The default is mantis_issues.
The time in seconds to wait for Meilisearch to answer, or to finish indexing a batch of issues. The default is 10.
